provenance: a recovery ladder whose rungs repeat the failed strategy is retry wearing a recovery label (taxonomy: rungs must be different strategies). This pins the rule as a truth table. Row 1: a dead text tier relocates to role+name found in the fresh snapshot. Row 2: a dead role+name relocates to text — never back to role+name, even though the fresh observation is right there to search. Row 3: a target carrying no name and no text has nothing to relocate BY, so the honest answer is no rung and a loud locate failure, not a guess. Row 4 is the trap: the name IS in the observation, and rung 1 must still be refused because role+name is exactly what just failed.
